verdict: DECISIVE on the relight question, control-INDEPENDENTLY: the #1480 relight (B) REGRESSES hard — median 2.5, UNANIMOUS last place — because it introduces a NEW vertical-banding artifact every scorer named ('vertical/diagonal banding/stripe artifact overlays the whole frame, breaks cohesion badly'). Only the backdrop shader changed A->B, so the 5.0-point unanimous drop is attributable to the relight alone (no reliance on the invalid control). Root cause: the crude shared greybox depth/normal sidecars (2 flat walls + 2 simple pillars) relighting a far richer, high-contrast warm plate (carved pillars, sarcophagus, arch) print through as stripe/seam banding — invisible on iter3's low-contrast COOL plate (same shader+sidecars, no banding), visible here. The relight's own premise (a cool/flat plate needs geometric relighting to add warmth) is INVALIDATED by a plate that arrives warm+firelit: it can only darken and stamp the greybox seams onto it. (Secondary, control-soft: A_flat's high absolute 7.5 is consistent with the warm styled plate integrating well, but that is advisory here — see secondary_observation + house_anchor_note.)
recommendation: STOP the relight loop; do NOT port relight to the shipped path. Keep WOSRelight default-OFF (already additive / all-uniforms-default-0 / byte-compatible when unset — no shipped code lights it, so nothing to gate off; the #1480 merge stays safe-dormant). Basis = the control-independent relight regression, NOT this panel's absolute numbers. The styled-plate pipeline remains the cohesion path, but its ADOPTION rests on the plate-sprint anchor panel (plate tied crypt_dense_v1 at 8.0), not on this control-invalid panel; before any promotion re-run a FELT/visual panel with an in-band control + the house anchor. If relight is ever revisited it needs a PER-PLATE depth/normal sidecar (from that plate's own conditioning geometry), not the crude shared greybox — that mismatch is the binding banding defect. Diminishing returns: 4 A/B rounds (#1469 registration; #1479 black-voids; #1469-iter3 tied on a cool plate; #1481 relight LOSES on the warm plate it was waiting for). No lever remains for the relight-shader. STOP.
